messages:
sara: quick thought — building a small "degrade handoff" flow in console. goal: let operators create rules that route traffic to cheaper/safer paths automatically and validate them before commit. thinking panels: rule summary, live-estimate (qps affected, % traffic), sample-log viewer (redacted), dry-run mode, and a revert timer. feedback?

ben: love it. for sample-logs please side-panel only, redact PII by default and show diff between original and degraded output. link to forensic audit index for deep dive.

jules (product): must include an actionability column: who to notify (pager/email/Slack) and auto-revert window. defaults: notify on first flip, revert after 15m if errors persist. also need a human-ack override to stop auto-revert.

vikram: API sketch for a rule (compact):
```json
{"id":"r_202","scope":"service:chat","trigger":{"metric":"p50_latency","op":">","value_ms":800,"window_s":120},"action":{"mode":"soft_degrade","fallback":"redwood-small-q4","sample_pct":0.01,"hysteresis_s":60,"cooldown_s":300}}
```
sampling deterministic by request-hash so reproducible examples.

sara: UX notes: in preview show estimated cost delta and latency delta if we had historical traffic. live-estimate should have confidence band. add a small "what changes" tooltip that lists param diffs (model, temp, truncation).

ben: retention + quota concerns: sampled logs tie to customer audit quota. recommend a per-rule cap (e.g., 1000 samples/day) and an org-level cap. UI should show remaining quota when enabling sample_pct.

jules (product): also expose a "dry-run -> replay" flow: operators can run a short replay of stored requests through the degrade decision engine to validate without impacting live traffic. mark replayed results as simulated in audit.

vikram: audit event example we'll emit on decision: 
```json
{"ts":"...","route":"/v1/chat","rule":"r_202","decision":"soft_degrade","reason":"p50>800","sampled":true,"sample_id":"h-abc123"}
```
we'll index these with rollout-change events so join queries are straightforward.

ben: edge-cases: noisy spikes causing flip-flop. default hysteresis 60s + cooldown 5m seems OK. UI should allow setting both but warn for aggressive values.

sara: agree. also show a tiny timeline sparkline in the rule card with flip events, so operator can eyeball stability.

ops-bot: config-lint: rule schema validated for r_202, no conflicts detected (lint v2.1).

vikram: action items: i'll open a spec PR for the rule API + audit shape and include replay endpoint.

jules (product): i'll prototype the console cards and a mock of the dry-run replay modal.

ben: i'll write quota/retention recommendations and an admin UI for quota budgeting.

sara: thanks all. want a 30m sync tomorrow 9:30 to review PR + mock. ping me if blockers. :white_check_mark:
